title: R3: Cut read-and-Continue tours; at most one Continue scene per lesson (S)
description:
Effort: S. Do first.

**Problem.** Reading replaces doing.
**Evidence.** Lesson 1 scenes meet, the-card, the-box, did-it, big-idea are Continue-only (one action in six scenes); about half of scenes in 01-05 are Continue-only; lesson 5 spends two scenes on 'its name is a label' and the log.
**Change.** Merge each tour line into the scene that needs it (say next to the action); keep one closing line as doneSay. Lesson 1 becomes two scenes (card, Run) plus one line about where the course goes.
**Acceptance.**
- Given lessons 1-5, then each has at most one Continue-only scene.
- Time to first action is under 20 s per lesson.
- npm run lesson -- check --all passes.
right_now_summary: The team is cutting read-only scenes so learners act sooner, with one Continue scene per lesson.
